rawContent: A fantastic and amazing interview. Thanks Beverly so much for this! @BeverlyBain13 #BlackLivesMatter

We need to refuse these PR and demobilization stunts! They just become another way of collaborating with and giving cover to the police. We need de-funding the police on the way to abolishing the police as an institution. #BlackLivesMatter
"Justice is Indivisable: Faculty for Palestine In Solidarity With Black-Led Justice Movements Against Racism and Police Violence"  https://t.co/Ftl5ode3Bp #BlackLivesMatter

Gary Kinsman, "Some notes on the uprisings against anti-Black Racist Capitalism and the possibilities for Hope: Resisting Both Repression and Liberal Containment https://t.co/jHabKJ4Omj #BlackLivesMatter

Still not going nearly far enough. Defund and disarm the police means a lot more that a 10% budget cut. It is a first step towards abolishing the police not reinforcing the police in important areas. #BlackLivesMatter

Yes guilt can be immobilizing and we need action and solidarity. But this must be based on a central challenge to white supremacy and white privilege including within the left. https://t.co/hohV6jC3iW  #BlackLivesMatter

But absolutely no support for de-funding the police and no mention of the position passed overwhelmingly at the Toronto Pride AGM in 2019 opposing any increase in the Toronto police budget. @PrideToronto #BlackLivesMatter
Sorry I must apologize. I read this statement way too fast and I missed the reference to support for de-funding the police. I am sorry to have spread misinformation. @PrideToronto #BlackLivesMatter
It is very weak statement but it does actually call for de-funding the police. It is there but I missed it in my quick read. At the same time it is vague and unclear. @PrideToronto #BlackLivesMatter
Volunteer for the Abolish the Police in Canada: A Pride Rally & Teach-In, Sunday June 28th, 2pm Nathan Philips Square, Toronto. https://t.co/DPaODEc8Nn #BlackLivesMatter #DefundThePolice
Sponsors now include @BLM_TO, Blackness Yes - Blockorama, No More Silence, @SURJto, Toronto Overdose Prevention Society and Queer Ontario. #DefundPolice, #BlackLivesMatter

And now also including @OCAPtoronto and @WorkersAC 
#BlackLivesMatter #DefundThePolice #PRIDE2020

Certainly not good enough! Really simply defending the police as an institution including their racism and violence. I support the @BLM_TO demand for a 50% budget reduction as we defund, disarm, demilitarize and dismantle the police. #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

Please consider signing onto this important statement for abolishing the police across the Canadian state (including the RCMP) that is based on support for the demands of @BLM_TO  Both organizations and individuals can sign. #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter
This is not what democracy looks like! #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

Yes shame! They did not listen or learn from any of the communities affected by police violence and Anti-Black and Anti-Indigenous racism. And the 10% cut was not even a real cut to their budget. No Justice, No Peace, Abolish the Police! #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter
Yes but we need far more than this.We need to defund and abolish the police at all levels including the RCMP. #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

But with the city officials deciding there will be no de-funding, disarming or de-militarization of the police there is no pressure on the police to listen to any critiques. We need a movement for de-funding and abolishing the police. #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

Great project! Do you already have the statement initiated by the No Pride in Policing Coalition calling for de-funding and abolishing the police across the Canadian state. This includes the RCMP. If not I can get it to you. #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

We need as many signers -- both organizations and individuals -- by next Wed. July 15th as at all possible. Please consider signing on to defund and abolish the police. #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

Please sign onto the "Defund and Abolish All Police" statement initiated by the No Pride in Policing Coalition by July 15th. See  https://t.co/dOWxOWgmTN or a direct link to to the pdf, at: https://t.co/uNj349yCC7   #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

Please save this date and time. More info. to follow. NO to Body cams and expanded police budgets! De-fund and Abolish the Toronto Police. Thursday, July 16th, 12 noon at Toronto Police HQ (College near Bay). #DefundthePolice #BlackLivesMatter
ASL interpretation will be provided. Also supported by Showing Up for Social Justice - Toronto. Please bring masks and physically distance. See you on Thursday. #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter
There will be ASL interpretation at this event. It is also supported by No More Silence. Please bring and wear masks and physically distance. See you on Thursday! #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter
The rally is now also supported by the Ontario Coalition Against Poverty. #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter
In response to Mayor Tory's statement yesterday we are calling for major cuts to the police budget and no cuts to the community and social services that we need. #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

Tomorrow at noon. Presenting demands to Toronto Police Services Board for defunding and abolishing the police. Also calling for the police budget to be cut and not our needed community and social services. #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

The rally to defund and abolish the police is going ahead regardless of the weather tomorrow at noon at Toronto Police HQ. If it looks like rain bring umbrellas if you have them. See you tomorrow!
